atheris.scope: optional extra 'fuzz' (Requires-Dist: atheris>=2.3; extra == 'fuzz'); fuzz CI job only; wheels exist for linux x86_64 only

colorama.scope: transitive of pytest on Windows only (sys_platform == 'win32'); dev/CI

hypothesis.scope: optional extras 'dev' and 'fuzz'; CI test lock (requirements/ci.txt)

maturin.scope: PEP 517 build backend (build-system.requires maturin>=1.10,<2.0); CI/package locks pin 1.15.0, publish-pypi.yml uses maturin-action binary v1.14.1; build tool, contributes no code to the wheel

numpy.scope: runtime dependency (Requires-Dist: numpy>=1.24); installed separately by the user from PyPI, never bundled in the fast-mlsirm wheel or sdist

packaging.scope: optional extra 'dev'; CI test lock; package-job build tooling

pyproject-hooks.scope: transitive of build (package CI job only)
